articles.title: NMDPRA, NLNG move to crash cooking gas prices

articles.hausa_translation: NMDPRA, NLNG suna kokarin rage farashin gas mai girki - Jambataccin NLNG ya ce aikin Train 7 zai kara ƙarfin samarwar LNG na kamfanin da wasu 7.5 MTPA, zai kawo jimillar ƙarfinta zuwa kusan 30 MTPA.
critical_questions: Who benefits most from increased LNG capacity - domestic Nigerian consumers or export markets, and what percentage of Train 7 output is allocated to domestic cooking gas supply?
What is the timeline for Train 7 completion and when will price reductions actually materialize for average Nigerian households buying cooking gas?
Why is NMDPRA's specific role and enforcement mechanism unclear in this initiative, and what regulatory teeth does it have to prevent price manipulation?

The Director-General of NAFDAC, Prof. Mojisola Adeyeye, disclosed this in a statement issued on Friday, saying […]
articles.hausa_translation: NAFDAC ta lalata kayan daukar, da jiya lokacin da suka ƙare, da marubuta kayayyaki da ba su da inganci waɗanda ke da ƙimar Naira biliyan 100, a matsayin ɗan yunƙuri na kariya jama'a da hana kayayyaki masu cutarki daga komawa cikin kasuwa ta Najeriya.

articles.hausa_translation: APC a Enugu ya dakatar da jingina sakamakon mutuwar direktan kuɗi. Festus Oshaba-Onuh, shugaban kamfanin Ferotex Construction Company Limited, ya mutu jiya yayin tafiya daga Port Harcourt zuwa Enugu don haɗuwa da jinginar jam'iyyar da aka shirya jiya.
critical_questions: What were the circumstances of death? Was it a natural death, accident, or other cause, and why isn't this specified?

What financial irregularities or sensitive matters might be under the finance director's purview that could explain heightened party sensitivity?
Are there independent verification of this death, or is this information solely sourced from APC statements?

In the Federal Capital Territory (FCT), for some residents, packaged and […]
